positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designing SWM : Designed detailed development methods, for example, how many threads needed to meet requirement from vendor or what functions needed for the features. Also, pseudo code also provided at this point, following Agile/Scrum.

- Implementing SWM :
o Based on detailed design, actual features implemented, following Agile/Scrum.
o Basic functions of SWM : SW/FW installation, managing tasks, monitoring other software blocks and request/receive peripheral devices, such as RRH(Remote Radio Head), PSU(Power Supply Unit) or Etc.
o Send/receive packets between hardware and software through socket communication.
o Thread/task management and control
o Process monitoring
o Modify or create SWM code functions to meet custom requirement for each vendors, such as Verizon, Sprint, KDDI(Japan), SKT(Korea), Reliance(India) or Etc.

- Testing SWM :
o UT(Unit Test) : Validate input/output values for each SWM code functions
o BT(Block Test) : Test all SWM functionalities and interaction between SWM and other blocks.
o SIT(System Integration Test) : Test on actual testbed connected to LSM(LTE System Manager, GUI system) with SNMP(Simple Network Management Protocol)

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Designed and implemented database analysis tool to integrate all of system related data of LTE system. This tool is created to analyze logs of malfunction that are generated by the system.

projects.title: Human Ear Recognition using Geometrical Features Extraction
projects.description:
Implementation of Human ear recognition simulator by using MATLAB.

• Greedy Snake Model was used as main algorithm.
• Smoothing the ear image by Gaussian filter.
• Greedy snake model was used to detect the object in image by clicking manually on the image.
• Then, median filter was applied to remove noise from image. Second, image was converted to binary image. Third, canny edge detector was used to find the edges by looking for local maximum of the gradient.
• Find the distance between centroid and control points on the ear and get minimum Euclidean distance between every pixel and all pixels.
• The simulator marked accuracy of 93%.

projects.title: Simulation for Multi-Symbol Detection of M-DPSK
projects.description:
• Implemented simulation for Multi-Symbol Detection of M-DPSK from 'Global Telecommunications Conference and Exhibition 'Communications Technology for the 1990s and Beyond' (GLOBECOM), 1989. IEEE' by using MATLAB.
• Both of Optimal symbol detection and Suboptimal symbol detection methods were implemented and simulated.
